reason: I only buy gummies or drinks because I hate swallowing pills, and this is 2 capsules every night. The lab report and the guarantee are nice, but the format is a dealbreaker for me.
objection: It is capsules, and two of them a day. I would not stick with it, so even a good price does not matter.
would_change_my_mind: A gummy or a powder drink version with the same tested magnesium bisglycinate dose.
